scope: Read the current guest screen and MAME profile without graphical input, before the next GTK2 horizontal stepper comparison.

method.capture: Read-only manager.machine.screens[':apollo_screen:screen']:snapshot(path) through the correlated project MAME bridge.
method.bridge_after: capture completed with correlated reply; no pending request or input operation

observation.screen_state: The 1024x800 guest desktop region is uniformly black (RGB 0,0,0); the Apollo command strip remains visible at the bottom.
observation.target: No VUE window, horizontal scrollbar, pointer target or GTK2 comparison target is visible.
observation.comparison_to_R437: R437 showed the VUE desktop and a horizontal scrollbar; R444 shows the guest desktop region black. The state changed between captures.

result.classification: Fresh read-only state check; the guest image is not currently usable for the held-arrow comparison.
result.interpretation: Do not infer an application, theme or disk failure from the black guest region. No wake input was attempted because verify.sh detects the separate active Prancheta MAME process.

next: When the separate MAME no longer blocks the guarded input path, revalidate the current project PID/disk and bridge, wake the project guest with the documented one-frame Shift attempt if still black, then capture the visible horizontal GTK2/VUE target before any press. Do not send input to the other VM.
